field_principles.adamflip_violation_mean: Baseline for comparison; needed so the ratio is auditable.
field_principles.casal_violation_mean: Primary comparison metric; expected much lower under hard-constraint sampling.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Terminal-prefix required. Use complete: if CASAL violation <= AdamFLIP/2.

field_principles.random_seed: Reproducibility: both regimes use the same seed for fair comparison.
